Employer or policy group behind the member's policy (Final_Policy_Group), looked up by member_id from the premium and policy data shared by the DABI team; '-' if the member is not in that data.
Type of policy, for example Group vs. Individual (Final_Policy_Type), from the premium and policy data shared by the DABI team; '-' if not found.
1 if the member had a claim billed for type 2 diabetes (E11) as a chronic condition in the last 12 months (Nov 2025 to Oct 2026).
1 if the member had a claim billed for hypertension (I10) as a chronic condition in the last 12 months (Nov 2025 to Oct 2026).

How diabetes shows in the historical claims data: DX + RX (diagnosed and filling diabetes medicines), DX only (diagnosed, no diabetes medicine filled through Daman), RX only (filling diabetes medicines but never billed with E11), Not T2D.
The same for hypertension (I10 diagnosis and blood-pressure medicines): DX + RX, DX only, RX only, Not HTN.

Network attachment, first that applies: In PHG network for the specified condition in 2026 (a 2026 diabetes claim at SEHA or SSMC); In PHG network for other chronic conditions in 2026; In PHG for chronic conditions prior to 2026; In PHG for non-chronic conditions (only acute care at PHG since 2024); Not in PHG network.

Network attachment, first that applies: In PHG network for the specified condition in 2026 (a 2026 hypertension claim at SEHA or SSMC); In PHG network for other chronic conditions in 2026; In PHG for chronic conditions prior to 2026; In PHG for non-chronic conditions (only acute care at PHG since 2024); Not in PHG network.
Gross written premium for the member, AED, from the premium data shared by the DABI team; '-' if not found.
Risk premium for the member, AED, from the premium data shared by the DABI team; '-' if not found.

1 = left out of outreach. Any of: cancer claim in the last 24 months (flag_oncology_l24m); outside the PHG network with 75%+ of outpatient encounters at one provider and more than one outpatient encounter (loyal out-of-network member); palliative / hospice / long-term care; dialysis or an AV-access procedure in the last 12 months; transplant; advanced neurological or major congenital condition; psychiatric inpatient stay, active substance use or advanced dementia; ventilator / TPN / 24-hour home nursing; pregnant or post-partum; more than 60% of cost since 2024 in one episode; specialty medicines more than 60% of cost since 2024. Each part is its own column further right.

1 if any of these was billed on any claim since January 2024: kidney disease of any kind, dialysis, stroke, heart failure, heart attack, or a diabetic kidney, eye, foot or circulation complication (flag_any_kidney_disease, flag_dialysis, flag_stroke, flag_heart_failure, flag_mi, flag_dm_kidney, flag_dm_eye, flag_dm_foot, flag_dm_circulatory).
1 if emergency visits plus hospital admissions in the last 12 months (ed_visits_l12m + ip_admissions_l12m) total 2 or more.
1 if a diabetes or BP medicine ran out more than 30 days ago, or adherence (PDC) is below 0.8 for non-insulin diabetes medicines or for BP medicines.
1 if the first diabetes (E11) or hypertension (I10) claim was in the 180 days before the review date (31 Oct 2026).
1 if no GP and no specialist consultation in the last 6 months, or the member has diabetes and no HbA1c test billed in the 365 days before the review date.
1 if the latest HbA1c is above 7% (values between 3 and 20 only), or the latest systolic blood pressure is above 130 mmHg (values between 60 and 260 only).

One persona per member, the first that applies: 1. Complications (P1), 2. Recurrent ED/IP (P2), 3. Drifting from care (P3_slipping or P3_offradar), 4. Uncontrolled (P4), 5. Newly Diagnosed (P5), 6. Others / Stable.
1 if the member has diabetes and the latest HbA1c is 6.5% or more (values between 3 and 20 only).

1 if the member has diabetes and hypertension, is on neither an ACE inhibitor nor an ARB, and has diabetic kidney disease, CKD, heart attack, ischaemic heart disease or stroke (on any claim since January 2024).

1 if Trig2a or Trig2b is 1.

1 if Trig5a, Trig5b or Trig5c is 1.

1 if the member has diabetes and any of: no HbA1c test in 180 days; latest HbA1c 7% or more and no test in 90 days; a hypo- or hyperglycaemia claim in the last 6 months and no test in 90 days; a new diabetes medicine class started in the last 90 days and no test since.

1 if the member has hypertension and either the newest ACE inhibitor, ARB, MRA or thiazide class started 14+ days ago with no potassium test since, or one of these is active with no potassium test in 365 days.

1 if on an ACE inhibitor or ARB with no potassium test in 365 days, or the member has diabetes and any of these is missing or older than 365 days: lipid panel, urine albumin, liver function, eGFR result, CBC, vitamin B12 (B12 only if metformin is active).

1 if dialysis, diabetic foot, amputation or diabetic neuropathy (any claim since January 2024), and no podiatry visit in the last 180 days.
Number of main triggers that are 1: Trig1 to Trig13 (the a / b / c sub-triggers are not counted separately). 0-13.
HbA1c points (H), from the latest HbA1c: 0 if below 7%, 1 if 7.0-7.9%, 2 if 8.0-8.9%, 3 if 9.0-9.9%, 4 if 10% or more; 0 when there is no result.

Clinical score C, maximum 5: HbA1c_score + 2 if hypertension (cohort_htn_l12m = 1) + 3 if DKA coded in the last 12 months (flag_dka_l12m) + 2 if hypoglycaemia coded in the last 12 months (flag_dm_hypoglycaemia_l12m), capped at 5.

Comorbidity and complication score M, maximum 6, from conditions billed on any claim since January 2024: dyslipidaemia 1 (first_dyslipidemia_date present), current smoker 1 (flag_current_smoker_l12m), obesity 1 (flag_obesity), stroke 3 (flag_stroke), heart failure 3 (flag_heart_failure), CAD / heart attack 3 (flag_mi or flag_ischemic_heart_disease), diabetic eye disease 2 (flag_dm_eye), diabetic neuropathy 1 (flag_dm_neuropathy), diabetic foot 4 (flag_dm_foot), amputation 4 (flag_amputation), diabetic circulation / PAD 3 (flag_dm_circulatory); total capped at 6.

Kidney points from lab results, maximum 5. eGFR (when there is a result): 4 if on dialysis (flag_dialysis), otherwise 0 if 60+, 1 if 45-59, 2 if 30-44, 3 if 15-29, 4 if below 15. Plus UACR (when there is a result): 0 if below 30 mg/g, 1 if 30-299, 2 if 300+.

Kidney score K, maximum 5: the lab-based points (eGFR + UACR points). When both eGFR and UACR are missing, the documented CKD stage is used instead (ckd_stage_l12m): Not documented / Stage 1-2 = 0, Stage 3a = 1, Stage 3b = 2, Stage 4 = 3, Stage 5 / kidney failure = 4.

Utilisation score U, maximum 5: diabetes / hypertension related ED visits in the last 12 months (l12m_ED_visits_DiaborHTNrelated) = 1 point each up to 3, plus related admissions (l12m_IP_admissions_DiaborHTNrelated): 1 admission = 3, 2 or more = 4; capped at 5.
Age and sex score A, 0-2. Men: under 40 = 0, 40-59 = 1, 60+ = 2. Women: under 45 = 0, 45-69 = 1, 70+ = 2.
Total risk score R = Clinical + Comorbidity + Kidney + Utilisation + Age/sex (0-23).
Tier from the total risk score: 0-3 = 4. Low, 4-7 = 3. Moderate, 8-12 = 2. High, 13+ = 1. Very High.
Programme the member is allocated to by tier: Very High or High = 'PREVHEATH'; Moderate or Low = 'PURECS'.
Safety flag, independent of the tier: 1 if DKA (flag_dka_l12m) or a hypoglycaemia was coded in the last 12 months.
